main_text.l: PARS II.
PSALMVS CXXXIII.

l.i: quàm bonum & quàm amœnum est habitare

main_text.l: CUM hoc scriptum institui-
mus, de re pernecessaria, nimi-
rum de pace Ecclesiæ dicturi,
hæc summa à nobis fuit pro-
posita instituti nostri: tandem
aliquando à pugnis & conten-
tionibus absisti oportere, & pacem quæ sit
secundùm Deum procurari, ut fructus illius am-
plissimos suavissimosque à Deo pacis assequa-
mur. Itaque sermonis instituti ordinem perse-
quentes, cùm ex Prophetæ verbis de procuran-
da pace & rebus ad eam pertinentibus in Psal-
mum antecedente dixerimus; nunc videndum
nobis est, ut de fructibus illius pacis secundo
loco adferamus quæ nobis à Spiritu sancto in
breuissimo hoc Psalmo fuerunt dictata. Est
enim hic Psalmus perbreuis quidé in speciem
indiculus; sed amplissimus argumento, spiri-
tualium fructuum illius pacis, quâ Deus cum
Ecclesia sua communicat, certissimam doctri-
nam conuenientissimo ordine comprehen-
dens.

page.notes: The large initial is an ornamental woodcut C, read as "CUM" joined to the first word. "Danidis" is printed for Davidis; kept as printed, probably a printing error. "amœnum" is read with some doubt from the scan; the ligature may be misread. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed: institui-mus, nimi-rum, pro-posita, conten-tionibus, am-plissimos, assequa-mur, perse-quentes, procuran-da, Psal-mum, spiri-tualium, comprehen-dens. The top-left page number is printed "2,32" in the scan; transcribed as 232.
